purpose: Historical prepared-rank evidence. Applied timings now come from the selected regional profile's shared main-runner metrics.
units: pixel displacement per emulator frame; all durations are emulator frames

evidence.speed_policy: the applied rate validated by the six-response trial
median pairwise slope of readable first-demo positions, then held fixed for six responses
median pairwise slope of readable first-demo positions, then held fixed for six responses

readability_policy: Unreadable observations retain their original frame numbers. Position calculations use readable observations and full frame-number differences.
cycle_policy: Same-leader midpoint spacing and the additional leader-switch spacing are separate from visible pointer speed.
response_policy: Use the retained full response endpoint; a transient missing strip alone does not establish completion.
evidence_retention: Compact accepted facts are retained here; detailed temporary captures may be cleared. Rank identity follows the prepared-source assignment.
